run_textual_inversion_training: run textual inversion training on a stable diffusion model with ONNXRuntime using a dataset of images and a placeholder token
save_textual_inversion_embeddings: save learned textual inversion embeddings from a text encoder to a binary file for later use in diffusion pipelines
validate_textual_inversion_model: validate a trained textual inversion model by generating images from a prompt and logging them to tensorboard or wandb
create_textual_inversion_dataset: create a textual inversion dataset from a directory of images with random templates, resizing, and tokenization for training
save_textual_inversion_model_card: save a model card README with YAML metadata and example images for a textual inversion model pushed to the Hugging Face Hub
